install_pplbench_package: install the pplbench package using pip install with optional ppls or dev extras
configure_pplbench_dependencies: configure pplbench dependencies including pystan, pymc3, pyro-ppl, numpyro, and beanmachine
run_pplbench_cli: run the pplbench console script entry point via the pplbench command
check_python_version: check that the python version is at least 3.7 before installing
read_pplbench_version: read the pplbench version string from the __init__.py module file
